scope: t131 documentation freshness only; no readiness or accounting authority

obligations.removal_test: A reviewed port entry contract defines the admitted entries and supplies a checked invariant or coverage argument for their selector paths; a single sampled arrival is insufficient.

For every admitted box-taking entry, a checked write-range/frame-preservation argument or enforced guard excludes the demonstrated Move alias and all other control-frame writes; alternatively the entry contract proves all box calls excluded.

Reviewed same-entry original/C evidence validates the remaining selected clear/title/printer and common-tail effects under the port contract, or checked path evidence excludes the named callees; compare the declared CPU/RAM/display/events/stop contract.
The admitted entry contract has a checked loaded-stub/target invariant or enforced guard excluding cold calls, or a reviewed original/C loader comparison establishes the required cold-call behavior.

A checked read-time length/argument-preservation bound excludes the 255-byte printer case for admitted entries, or the port contract and comparison explicitly validate that case's nontermination semantics without treating budget exhaustion as return.
